# Axial Skyrmions

- It is noted that this reflection alters the sign of only a single pion field, and consequently the definition of the relative phase differs by an addition of π compared with that of refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is produced by reversing the sign of all three pion fields; the definition adopted in this paper allows a more natural comparison with the analogous situation for monopoles.
- The profile function vanishes at a distance s/2 from the centre of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), as expressed in (3.10), so that the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion are joined together continuously, with the fields fixed to the vacuum outside each of the cores.
- Beyond the initial conditions constructed from the simple ansatz (3.7), more refined initial conditions were also employed, drawing on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
